article_title: More students planning to live at home for uni over 'insane' living costs

tasks.prompt: What is the article's main point?
options: Rising living costs are leading a record share of new UK students to plan to live at home while studying
UK universities have stopped offering student accommodation
Most students now reject university degrees for full-time employment
Tuition fees have been replaced entirely by rent payments
tasks.correct_answer: Rising living costs are leading a record share of new UK students to plan to live at home while studying
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מתארת כיצד עלויות המחיה הגבוהות גורמות ליותר סטודנטים חדשים מאי פעם בשנים האחרונות לבחור לגור בבית.

tasks.prompt: About how many UK 18-year-olds with accepted university applications said they intended to live at home?
options: About 8,100
More than 81,000
About 810,000
Fewer than 1,800
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי נתוני UCAS, יותר מ־81 אלף בני 18 בבריטניה עם קבלה לאוניברסיטה ציינו שהם מתכוונים לגור בבית.

tasks.prompt: What proportion of the relevant accepted applicants planned to live at home?
options: Just over one in three
Exactly one in ten
Nearly every applicant
Less than one in fifty
tasks.explanation_hebrew: מדובר בקצת יותר משליש מן המועמדים בקבוצה שנבדקה.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does “commute” mean?
options: To change to a different degree
To receive a maintenance loan
To rent a room on campus
To travel regularly between home and university
tasks.correct_answer: To travel regularly between home and university
tasks.explanation_hebrew: commute פירושו לנסוע באופן קבוע בין הבית למקום הלימודים או העבודה.

tasks.prompt: What did one student gain by making a 90-minute commute?
options: A guaranteed university job
Savings of more than £7,000 on accommodation
Free tuition for the whole degree
A larger maintenance loan than every other student
tasks.correct_answer: Savings of more than £7,000 on accommodation
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הסטודנטית שתוארה בכתבה חסכה יותר מ־7,000 ליש״ט על מגורים באמצעות נסיעה של כ־90 דקות.

tasks.prompt: Why might students such as Jessica feel they have “no choice” but to stay at home?
options: They are not allowed to join campus activities
Their degrees can only be studied online
Accommodation and other living costs may be unaffordable even though they fear missing student life
UCAS requires all 18-year-olds to live with parents
tasks.correct_answer: Accommodation and other living costs may be unaffordable even though they fear missing student life
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הבחירה נובעת מלחץ כלכלי, אף שהסטודנטים חוששים להחמיץ את החוויה החברתית של החיים בקמפוס.

tasks.prompt: Give two pieces of evidence that living at home has become a significant trend among new students.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שתי ראיות מספריות או השוואתיות שמופיעות בכתבה.
expected_points: More than 81,000 UK 18-year-olds said they intended to live at home
This was just over one in three in the relevant accepted-applicant category
The figure was the highest in nine years
The trend was based on UCAS accepted-application data

tasks.prompt: Explain one financial benefit and one educational or social cost of commuting from home.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג תועלת כספית ברורה ומחיר אפשרי ללימודים או לחיי החברה, ולקשור אותם לפרטי הכתבה.
expected_points: Students can avoid or reduce rent and accommodation costs
One example saved more than £7,000
A long commute takes time and can be tiring
Students may miss campus events, friendships or independence
Travel costs partly reduce the savings
The balance depends on distance and household circumstances

tasks.prompt: Summarise why more students intend to live at home and the trade-offs they face.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשור בין יוקר המחיה להחלטה ולתאר גם את היתרון וגם את החיסרון.
expected_points: Living and accommodation costs have risen sharply
A record number or share of accepted 18-year-olds plan to stay home
Living at home can produce substantial savings
Some students undertake long commutes
They may worry about missing student life or independence
Financial pressure makes the decision feel necessary rather than ideal

tasks.prompt: A university wants to support students who live at home. Propose two practical measures and justify them using problems raised in the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציע שני צעדים מעשיים ולנמק כיצד כל אחד מטפל בקושי כלכלי, לימודי או חברתי מן הכתבה.
expected_points: Timetables grouped into fewer campus days could reduce commuting
Travel grants or discounted transport could lower costs
Flexible or hybrid access could help with long journeys
Late study spaces or lockers could support commuters
Clubs and events scheduled for commuter participation could reduce social exclusion
Financial guidance or hardship support could address living-cost pressure
